items.name: ChessLens
items.summary: End-to-end bounded-memory data engineering, leakage-controlled ML evaluation, and ONNX inference platform built on 10.64M Lichess games and 718.56M moves.
highlights: Engineered a bounded-memory, restartable Python/PyArrow ETL pipeline processing 10.64M games and 718.56M moves into 43 checksummed Parquet shards using concurrent workers, a single-writer manifest with ordered commits, HMAC player anonymization, and crash recovery.

Built a DuckDB + dbt warehouse validating a deterministic 10% sample across 8 dbt models and 39 automated data-quality tests (keys, move counts, feature boundaries), with process-tree memory and throughput profiling.

Trained LightGBM and multi-task PyTorch residual CNN models (legal-move masking, checkpoint recovery, MLflow + Optuna tracking) evaluated with temporal and player-disjoint holdouts, NDCG, Brier score calibration, and game-level bootstrap uncertainty intervals.
Built a typed FastAPI + ONNX Runtime inference service with artifact integrity checks, PyTorch-vs-ONNX ranking parity tests, and GitHub Actions CI.

items.name: Multi-Party Conversational AI for Discord
items.summary: Event-driven, asynchronous Discord AI agent engineered for real-time multi-party channels using two-stage LLM routing, conversation state tracking, and structured RAG.
highlights: Designed a two-stage LLM routing engine combining deterministic rules (explicit mentions, replies, active turn decay) with a lightweight structured LLM classifier for ambiguous follow-ups to minimize unnecessary model calls and token spend.
Implemented stateful channel activity and turn-lifecycle tracking so the agent responds naturally to indirect follow-ups and disengages cleanly when conversations shift.
Built a shared DuckDB RAG pipeline indexing dialogue across four personas with speaker, scene, and branch metadata to preserve consistent, grounded character responses.
Built an evaluation framework measuring routing recall, false-engagement rate, model calls per 1,000 messages, and token efficiency against rule-only baselines.

items.name: Sustentra ESG Evidence Platform
items.summary: Full-stack, schema-driven document intelligence and multi-tenant audit workflow platform for regulated ESG reporting (ISO 14064, ISSA 5000, NY Part 253).
highlights: Built a Python document-intelligence pipeline (AWS S3, Amazon Textract, OpenAI API) processing 40+ multi-page client filings in ≤30s with >99% client-validated field accuracy, 98% first-pass JSON schema validation, and page/cell-level source traceability.
Translated regulatory standards into versioned JSON schemas and deterministic validation libraries integrating 90 formula records, 63 combustion emission factors, and 20 evidence categories.

Scaffolded a FastAPI + React/TypeScript web platform (Docker Compose), implemented immutable review-decision APIs, added PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) multi-tenant isolation tests with Alembic migrations, and shipped a unit-tested SMTP/Amazon SES authentication email service via peer code reviews and CI.
Built a 7-stage Streamlit audit prototype backed by 170+ passing tests and synthetic-evidence smoke-test guides, presenting live workflows to 10+ audit and client stakeholders.

items.name: Met Museum Cross-Modal Search
items.summary: Bidirectional text-to-image and image-to-text retrieval engine over the Met Open Access collection with contrastive PyTorch projection heads and FAISS indexing.
highlights: Precomputed DINOv2 image embeddings and Sentence Transformer text embeddings, trained contrastive projection heads, and built FAISS similarity indexes decoupled from request serving.
Exposed unified retrieval across typed FastAPI REST endpoints, a CLI, and an interactive Streamlit interface with cached artwork metadata.

items.name: Recipe Discovery & Semantic Search
items.summary: Hybrid and multimodal recipe search with custom clustering and an interactive exploration interface.
highlights: Combined SBERT dense embeddings with TF-IDF retrieval, and added SigLIP image, text, and combined image-text multimodal search over the Food.com Recipes and Interactions dataset.
Implemented dietary filters, negative-feedback query refinement, optional rating-aware reranking, and a session-based shopping list.

Built a PyTorch k-means++ implementation (Lloyd updates, empty-cluster reseeding, multiple restarts) with silhouette evaluation, plus PCA and autoencoder embedding views for interactive cluster exploration.

items.name: NYC Taxi Autoencoder Demo
items.summary: A PyTorch autoencoder demo for exploring a two-dimensional latent representation of taxi data.
highlights: Prepared numeric inputs for an autoencoder-based two-dimensional representation.
Exposed training and validation loss alongside an interactive Streamlit/Plotly view.

items.name: Chunithm Request Bot
items.summary: A Discord bot for managing Chunithm song requests during livestream sessions.
highlights: Added fuzzy song matching and owner-controlled request sessions.
Managed three-song request queues with SQLite persistence.
